then.say: You made it! Told you I'd be here. Look at this: a real stall. Well. A table with a roof.
I owe you. When I've got stock worth selling, you get first pick. Powder, shot, the good stuff.

else.say: My favourite customer. My only customer, but still.

then.say: Not much yet! A few things I scrounged on the road, and whatever the carters leave behind.
Clear the way to the Works and the Mire and more comes through. Trade follows the brave, and I follow the trade.

else.say: Take your time. Touch nothing you won't buy.

menu.text: Where does your stock come from?

do.say: Some from the road. The good stuff was hidden in the old powder stores under the Works, before the Order sealed them.
I drew a map, if you've the Tallow. Friends' rates.

menu.text: How did you end up on that wagon?

do.say: Sold powder to the wrong priest. Or the right priest, and he got caught. Either way the Order needed a penitent, and I was handy.
Mind the Hill Stair. Things come down it after dark.
